name: dwell-on-something
tagline: Functional documentation written like literature, with a product-grade frontend
description: dwell-on-something is a documentation project that pairs functional documentation with a frontend built to the standard of a running product — and it comes out of China. What makes it remarkable is the writing: the documentation is composed like literature rather than a manual. An unusual approach to docs that earned 121 stars in under a week and signals a broader trend of non-English ecosystems producing genuinely original work.
highlights: Documentation written like literature, not a manual
Frontend built to production product standards
Fresh perspective from the Chinese dev ecosystem
curatorNote: Docs are almost always utilitarian; treating them as a literary form with product-grade presentation is a genuinely rare bet — and it is working.
